protocol.name: exponential_popup_namespace_v1

description.summary: a namespace for an xdg_popup, as a layer surface has one

protocol.description:
#EXP-2041: Exponential Desktop's compositor keeps some of its shell's popups out of captures of the person's output (the taskbar's Agent spaces list shows the agent spaces' pictures). A layer surface names itself with its layer-shell namespace; an xdg_popup has no name. This global gives a popup's surface one.
The compositor reads a name only from the shell's own process, as it reads a layer's namespace (the shell's pinned space view, #EXP-2024): another client naming a popup the same is still in every capture. The one client in eDE that sends it is the shell (gpui's Wayland client, `apps/desktop/vendor/gpui-pre-linux`).

interface.name: exponential_popup_namespace_v1
interface.description: The global, announced to the person's clients only.

request.name: set_namespace
request.description: Names the surface that has, or will have, the xdg_popup role. Send it before the popup's first commit: the compositor decides once, when the name arrives, and a surface keeps the first name it is given (a later one is ignored).
